services.name: Private Pilates
services.desc: Julia Naftulin, EveryBody owner-operator, discovered Pilates to address chronic back pain from her years as a dancer. She has 23 years of experience teaching and specializes in pre/post-natal Pilates, pelvic floor Pilates (Pfilates), and diastasis recti repair. Her background in Dance/Movement Therapy and FAMO myofascial training make her approach holistic and well-rounded.She wants to help others to explore this foundational practice that teaches you to be strong on the inside and outside, and to experience movement in a deeper, more supported way.
